Welcome
Group Purchasing + Shared Delivery + Collective Wisdom

Fresh produce, smarter group delivery.

FarmLink Direct is planned as a Singapore-based platform using SGD for financial planning, with the first MVP pilot in Kuala Lumpur. It connects farm suppliers with restaurants, hotels and cafés, while available drivers self-accept delivery route legs through a shared task board.

1. Farms list produce
Price, stock, group target and delivery day🚜
2. Businesses order together
Ordered quantity moves toward the group target🤝
3. Farms confirm supply
Confirmed orders enter the delivery pool📦
4. Drivers add route wisdom
Zone tags and local knowledge improve shared delivery🗺️
Deployment scope: FarmLink Direct is planned as a Singapore-based company, so the proposal uses SGD as the financial unit. The initial MVP is piloted in Kuala Lumpur because it is a more practical first market for farm-to-hospitality sourcing. After the Kuala Lumpur pilot is validated, the platform can be deployed to other cities.
📊

Collective demand

Separate orders from restaurants, hotels and cafés are shown as one group-order progress bar, making shared purchasing visible.

🚚

Distance + weight delivery

Compatible orders in the same area and delivery day can be grouped into one delivery route, reducing repeated trips.

🧠

Driver route wisdom

Inspired by relay delivery systems, drivers use local route knowledge and simple zone codes to refine the delivery sequence.

🍽️

Restaurant / Hotel / Café

Search products, join group orders, manage a cart, place orders and track delivery progress.

🌾

Farm

Create and edit listings, review ordered quantity, confirm orders and prepare produce for pickup.

🗺️

Platform Delivery Coordinator

Group compatible orders, publish delivery legs, monitor driver acceptance and update delivery progress.

🚴

Driver

View open pickup, hub-transfer and final-mile tasks, then self-accept suitable delivery legs.
